plan_warnings: The dog is the largest new drawing (planned by AN-040, not yet in the Library) and carries the film: four instances plus an aged variant, with headDown, raise and collar fields added here. Build and approve it first.

Four large dogs, the seated stranger, two servants, three guests and the lord share one 1000-wide hall in S3 to S5: stage guests and lord small on the dais in the background and take the servants off by 45.8, or the frame will be crowded.

The front-facing person cannot show a profile: eating from the dish, the kneeling offer and the paw on the knee rely on hand targets (handLW / handRW) and gaze; check these read at phone size with stills.

Recognition of the poor owner depends on the round inset and the blue colour link, because the ascetic preset has a different beard and headwear from the merchant preset; if pal cannot keep the merchant beard shape, lean on the inset.
palaceHall is an interior; the script says courtyard. If the owner wants open sky, draw the sky through the arches with the outside(ctx) callback.

English paragraph 7 compresses the Arabic (it omits asking the way and the recognition) and paragraph 8 turns direct speech into reported speech; subtitles are verbatim in both languages, chunk pairs are aligned as closely as the texts allow.
